ambient_events: A cabin light goes on behind a curtain, then off again.
The walkway boards give under you, one soft note each.
Somebody's left boots outside their door, turned neatly toward the wall.
The VACANCY sign buzzes. The C in it has been dead for years.
Wind runs the length of the walkway, turns the corner, and is gone.
description: A covered concrete walkway runs the length of the motel, a strip of dead bug-zapper light buzzing overhead and a row of numbered doors down one side. Somebody's boots are drying on the mat.
name: The Walkway
